privacy_block_all_on.text: ✅ Other users can no longer compare their results with yours.

privacy_block_quiz_off.text: ✅ Comparing your results for “{name}” is allowed again.

privacy_block_quiz_on.text: ✅ Comparing your results for “{name}” is now forbidden.

privacy_choose_quiz_block.text: Which quiz should I change the comparison ban for? Reply with a number within 30 minutes (the current ban is in brackets):

privacy_choose_quiz_clear.text: Which quiz's results should I delete? Reply with a number within 30 minutes:

privacy_cleared_all.text: ✅ Deleted all of your quiz results.

privacy_header.text: Here you can control what the bot keeps about you. Reply with a number within 30 minutes:

privacy_none.text: The bot holds no data about you that you could configure.

privacy_opt_block_all.text: forbid other users from comparing my quiz results (currently forbidden: {state})

privacy_opt_block_one.text: forbid other users from comparing my results for individual quizzes

privacy_opt_clear_one.text: delete my results for individual quizzes

production_busy.text: You are already producing {name} — it will be ready in {time} min.

production_first_run.text: ⚡ Your first run is done at once — the next ones take a few minutes.

production_lucky.text: 🍀 A lucky run — the batch came out double: {qty} units.

production_started.text: 🏭 Production started: {name}{emoji} — a batch of {qty}, ready in {duration} min, cost {cost}.

production_too_many.text: You already have {limit} goods in production. Wait for one of them, or stop a 24/7 line.

progress_level_up.text: ⭐ Your quality level for {emoji}{name} is now {level}. Each unit is worth more, and the energy it costs grows more slowly than the worth — so the higher you go, the better the work pays.

quiz_answer_hint.text: Pick an option from the menu below, or type “Number-Answer”: Mb = slight preference, Y = definite (e.g. “2-Y” or “3 Mb”). The last options need only their number.

quiz_answer_invalid.text: I didn't understand that. Reply like “2-Y” or “3 Mb”; for the last options send just the number.

quiz_answer_need_weight.text: How strongly do you mean option {num}? Press a button below, or reply “{num}-Y” / “{num} Mb”.

quiz_answer_out_of_range.text: There is no option with that number. Pick a number from the list.

quiz_consent_prompt.text: Before the results: may I remember them? That way you'll be able to compare them later with your own past results or with other people. You can delete them anytime with /quizzes-clear.

quiz_not_saved.text: Alright, I won't store your results.

quiz_saved.text: Saved. You can remove it anytime with /quizzes-clear.

quiz_start_prompt.text:
You chose “{name}”.

You will be shown a topic with numbered statements. Reply in the form “Number-Answer” — put Mb after the number for a slight preference or Y for a definite one (e.g. “3-Y” or “2 Mb”). The last options (disagree with all / don't care / previous question) need only their number.

Shall we begin?

quiz_stop_none.text: You are not taking a quiz right now.

quiz_stop_saved.text: ⏸️ Your progress in “{name}” is kept for 7 days. Start this quiz again to continue from the same place; otherwise the progress is discarded.

quizzes_clear_header.text: Your saved results — reply with a number within 30 minutes to delete one:

quizzes_clear_none.text: You have no saved quiz results.

quizzes_compare_blocked.text: This user has forbidden comparing their quiz results.

quizzes_compare_header.text: Quizzes you have both completed — reply with a number within 30 minutes:

quizzes_compare_none.text: You and this user have no completed quizzes in common.

quizzes_compare_self.text: Choose someone other than yourself to compare with.

quizzes_compare_user_invalid.text: Give a valid user — a mention or an ID.

quizzes_list_header.text: Available quizzes — reply with a number within 30 minutes to begin:

quizzes_previous_invalid.text: There is no quiz with that number. The quiz list is /quizzes.

quizzes_previous_no_recent.text: More than 30 minutes have passed since you took a quiz. Give the quiz number: /quizzes-previous <number> (the list is /quizzes).

quizzes_previous_no_results.text: You have no saved quiz results.

quizzes_previous_none.text: You have no previous result for “{name}” — there is nothing to compare with.

rate_limited.text: Too many attempts — try again later.

remadmin_not_admin.text: User {user_id} is not an admin of this server.

remadmin_success.text: User {user_id} is no longer an admin of this server.

remadmin_usage.text: Usage: /remadmin <user ID or @username>, or reply to the user's message with /remadmin.

rules_invites_disabled.text: ✅ Party members may no longer invite new members.

rules_invites_enabled.text: ✅ Party members may now invite new members.

rules_menu_1.text: 1 — allow party members to invite new members (currently: {state})

sell_bad_target.text: I don't know that buyer. Name a member or an enterprise code.

sell_declined.text: The offer was declined. Nothing left the warehouse.

sell_no_bank.text: This good is not denominated in any currency, so it cannot be given a price.

sell_no_funds.text: The buyer cannot afford that price.

sell_not_sellable.text: “{name}” is a base good: it has no market value and is handed over with /give-good rather than sold.

sell_offer.text: 🤝 Offer to {buyer}: {qty} × {emoji}{name} for {price}. Do you accept?

service_event.left_unconfigured.text: 👋 {platform}: the bot left “{chat}” ({chat_id}) — {days} days have passed since it was added and it was never bound to a union with /setup.

service_event.parties_disabled.text: 🏛️ Parties were disabled in union {code} by {user}.

service_event.parties_enabled.text: 🏛️ Parties were enabled in union {code} by {user}.

service_event.party_created.text: 🏛️ Party {name} [{party}] was created in union {union} by {user}.

service_event.party_deleted.text: 🗑️ Party {name} [{party}] was deleted in union {union} by {user}.

service_event.setup_done.text: 🔗 {platform} chat “{chat}” was linked to union {union} by {user}.

set_earn_no_permission.text: Only this bank's leaders or a server admin can set earning channels.

set_earn_off.text: ✅ This channel no longer earns any currency.

set_earn_off_inherited.text: This place has no earning setting of its own — it earns the currency set on the channel around it. Switch it off there, or set a different currency here.

set_earn_on.text: ✅ This channel now earns {code} (rate ×{rate}). Threads and forum posts inside it earn the same, unless one names its own currency.

set_earn_wrong_union.text: This server does not belong to that bank's union.

set_rate_bad.text: The rate must be a positive number.

set_rate_multi.text: A manual peg is only allowed when the two banks are each other's only treaty partner.

set_rate_no_treaty.text: You have no treaty with that bank.

set_rate_offer.text: Peg proposal: 1 {a} = {rate} {b}. A leader of {b} may accept.

set_wage_no_good.text: No good in bank {bank} matches that profession.

setadmin_already.text: User {user_id} is already an admin of this server.

setadmin_dm.text: I now recognize you as an administrator of the server {server}.

setadmin_success.text: User {user_id} has been added as an admin of this server.

setadmin_usage.text: Usage: /setadmin <user ID or @username>, or reply to the user's message with /setadmin.

setchannel_bad_channel.text: That channel was not found on this server.

setchannel_bad_tz.text: Invalid timezone: use a UTC offset like UTC+3 or -05:30.

setchannel_bad_weekday.text: Invalid weekday: use 1–7 (1 = Monday) or an English name (mon…sun).

settasks_schedule.text: Task post: the 1st of each month at {time} ({tz}).

stats_task_bonus.text: Includes the bonus for completing last month's task.

suspend_confirm.text: Suspend the party {name}? Its information will remain, /party will mark it as suspended, and a leader can resume it later.

task_footer.text: The required part must be produced on this server/group; the optional part is a bonus. Progress appears in the weekly statistics.

task_intro.text: This month the server needs to produce:

task_prev_done.text: ✅ Last month's task was completed! The provision bonus is active.

task_prev_failed.text: ❌ Last month's task was not completed.

too_many_requests.text: Too many requests — try again later.

top_bad_kind.text: Choose a board: week, good <good code>, or wealth <currency code>.

top_no_server.text: This command works in a server chat, not in a private one.

top_none.text: Nobody is on this board yet.

treaty_exists.text: These banks already have a treaty.

treaty_offer.text: Bank {proposer} proposes a currency-conversion treaty with {name} [{code}]. A leader of {code} may accept.

treaty_self.text: A bank cannot make a treaty with itself.

verify_cooldown.text: Too many verification attempts. Try again in a few minutes.

verify_error.text: Could not reach Fandom right now. Please try again later.

verify_mismatch.text: The Discord handle on that Fandom profile (“{handle}”) does not match your Discord username (“{you}”).

verify_no_handle.text: {name} has no Discord account listed on their Fandom profile. Add it on your profile on any wiki, then run /verify again.

verify_not_found.text: No Fandom user named “{name}” was found.

verify_required.text: You must verify your Fandom account first with /verify <your Fandom username>.

verify_required_tg.text: You must verify first: run /add-discord here and /add-telegram on Discord to link your accounts (your Discord account must be verified with /verify).

verify_success.text: ✅ Verified as Fandom user {name}. You can now use the Fandom-activity commands.

sponsor_status.text: Tier {tier}. Unions {unions}/{union_limit}: {names}. Servers/groups {servers}/{server_limit}. Today: earning messages {activity}/{activity_limit}, at most {activity_minute} per minute. Subscribe at {url} and connect Patreon to Discord.

sponsor_not_active.text: No active Patreon role is linked to your Discord account.

sponsor_union_limit.text: This subscription has reached its union limit.

sponsor_setup_forbidden.text: You need an active subscription, Manage Server permission here, a union you own and a free server slot.

cmd_sponsor.text: /sponsor — show your subscription, unions and server slots

sponsor_grace_active.text: Payment ended; all sponsor features keep working for {days} more day(s).

sponsor_community_pending.text: Community-role benefits start in about {days} day(s) after the role was first observed.

sponsor_community_grace.text: Community role lost; benefits continue for {days} more day(s).

sponsor_retention_warning.text: The working grace period ended. Another active sponsor or bot administrator can take over; otherwise the bot leaves and the community data is deleted 30 days after grace ends.
